title: Performance Analysis of Underwater Quantum Key Distribution Protocols: BB84, SARG04, and BBM92
summary: This study compares the quantum bit error rate (QBER) performance of BB84, SARG04, and the entanglement-based BBM92 protocol in non-turbulent underwater optical channels. Clear, coastal, and turbid water types are considered under different background-illumination and receiver configurations. For BB84 and SARG04, channel attenuation and background-induced detections determine the quantum gain and QBER.
